abstract: Exposed to diverse pathogenic and non-pathogenic insults, the airway epithelium must balance effective host defense while minimizing unnecessary inflammation and tissue damage. In studies of influenza A virus infection including spatial transcriptomics, Nguyen et al. illustrate how tissue-level organization of viral sensing may tune the intensity of innate immune responses.
